localFacts.fact: Lufthansa allows one cabin bag of max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm and 8 kg; all four full-size picks (Sirui 31 cm, Peak Design 39,4 cm, Befree Advanced 40 cm, SmallRig CT-10 43 cm folded) are shorter than 55 cm.
Kölner Dom (Domordnung): private photos without flash are allowed, but recordings with tripods need permission from the Dompropst.
Humboldt Forum Berlin allows private photos, but tripods may not be used indoors.
German terms: Stativkopf, Kugelkopf, Mittelsäule, Schnellwechselplatte, Stativgewinde 1/4 Zoll; Arca-Swiss keeps its name.

localPainPoints.pain: Sony APS-C owners want a travel tripod for city and day trips that they will actually carry.
localPainPoints.fix: Sirui T-025SK (31 cm folded, 1 kg) or the PIXI EVO for a small sling (English decision list).

quotes.text: Ich würde mir zu meiner alpha 6000 gern ein Stativ Kaufen, welches ich auch mal mitnehmen kann, wenn ich unterwegs bin.

localPainPoints.pain: How tall a travel tripod must be; the centre column costs stability.
localPainPoints.fix: Thanks to the tilting screen, chest height is enough: rank on column-down height (Sirui 108 cm, Peak Design 130,2 cm) and keep the column down.

quotes.text: dank Klappdisplay reicht auch knapp über Hüfthoch ... die Mittelsäule sollte nur im Notfall ausgezogen werden, der Stabilität wegen.

localPainPoints.pain: Thin travel-tripod legs start to vibrate in light wind, so the maker's load rating says little.
localPainPoints.fix: English post: the a6400 kit is 519-1.028 g, so pick on legs and column-down height; spread the legs and hang the bag low.

quotes.text: Reisestative mit diesen dünnen Beinchen brechen nicht unter deiner Kamera zusammen. Aber sie fangen schon bei leichtem Wind an zu schwingen

localGain.point: Lufthansa 55 x 40 x 23 cm cabin-bag check for the four full-size picks.
Venue rules (Kölner Dom permit, Humboldt Forum no tripods indoors): where only the mini tripods or no tripod at all are realistic.
Maker metric figures, the EU kit code MKBFRLA4BK-BH for the Befree Advanced, and German forum advice on chest height with the flip screen.
